findings.summary: The node family's receiver bindings were a row shape of their own, carrying reconstructed names and a comparison bool only SDL_GPU read, so a node PCF receiver composed cleanly and failed Dawn's layout validation; the rows are now the shared PinnedShadowBinding, reflected out of the composed module and bound through per-row builders both backends share

An ESM caster pipeline's colour target was the generator's recorded row in Dawn and the frame's format in every SDL_GPU family, which that backend bakes into the D3D12 PSO's RTV list; the recorded row is now the answer in both backends, for all three families

assertShadowCapabilities refused a PBR-only ESM scene naming Standard as the only family with a caster view, which this wave made false; the ESM capability is now the same family union the receiver half is

Three new tests of generator.kind === 'esm-directional' bypassed pinnedShadowFilter, the one read that fails loudly on a generator family it does not know; every filter question routes through it again and the compiler-side record stopped carrying a classification it re-derived

The generated refusal for a node material cast into a PCF map was emitted only where nodeEsmCasters > 0, so in the case it was written to catch it was absent and the caster fell through to the PBR no-colour view; the refusal moved to composition, where the generator's filter and the scene site are both in hand

Three near-identical create_*_esm_shadow_material_view factories were emitted where the file's own no-colour siblings already show the shared-helper shape; one body takes the family, three wrappers name it

The ESM caster's shadowParams lookup was written three times per backend and its size four times; one esm_caster_params_buffer/esm_caster_params_for per backend and one shadow_params_block_bytes constant replace them

The ESM index was folded into the pipeline cache key by hand at three sites, each restating variant_pipeline_key's internal packing with its own list of false flags; esm_keyed_variant states the fold once beside the packing it depends on

The two node shadow counts were derived four times across two files, so the activation row compared an expression against itself rather than against a second derivation; nodeShadowInputs states them once
The caster-pass lights-block skip was gated on BBLITE_NODE_VARIANTS where BBLITE_NODE_SHADOWS is the property it guards, so any scene composing a node graph at all paid for a block no stage read

The generator-ordinal walk was copied out of shadow_group_for into the new node path, against that walk's own comment that a second spelling could disagree; shadow_generators_in_light_order serves both

Whether a composed PBR variant is an ESM caster view was answered by a per-pipeline linear scan for the literal name shadowParams; it is reflected onto PbrVariantEntry beside no_color_output, as the Standard family's flag already was
The caster stem ternary appeared six times across two backends and one call recovered the variant with a hand-written slot / 2; node_variant_stems and the slot inverse sit beside the packer
The caster's binding set was enumerated twice to answer one collision question, and the compiled-bindings shape was declared three times; one list answers both and one interface declares the shape
The shadow task emitted the ESM-vs-PCF fork three times across two independent template branches; one casterView(family) helper builds the arm and the emission interpolates it

A shadow caster recorded its material at the setShadowTaskCasterMeshes call and again through the mesh-material map that overwrote it, with a comment describing the assumption scene 65 broke; the map is now the one producer and the caster record carries only its mesh

compileShadowLights computed, validated and discarded a light index whose default arm could not fail, and a doc comment was left orphaned by the insertion; only a stated index is checked and the comment sits with the function it describes
PinnedNodeBuildState kept a shadowLights field for a refusal this wave deleted

node_variant_slots doubled four Dawn vectors and two SDL_GPU ones for every node scene, including those reaching no shadow; the packer and its inverse now collapse to identity under BBLITE_NODE_SHADOWS == 0, so a no-caster build keeps its old table sizes
